title: Two wardrobes in a loft room
summary: IKEA PAX wardrobes boxed in with MDF, one on each side of a loft room.
intro: A loft room with a window at one end and a wardrobe down each side. Each is a run of IKEA PAX frames, planned in IKEA's planner first, then boxed in with MDF panels and closed with full-height MDF doors.

cover.alt: Loft room with MDF wardrobes along both sides and a window at the end

image.alt: IKEA planner drawing of a two-section PAX wardrobe with drawers and hanging rails

real.alt: The finished wardrobe open, with drawers and hanging rails as planned

plan.title: Planned first, then built
plan.text: The inside was laid out in the IKEA PAX planner: 199.8 cm wide, 201.2 cm high and 58 cm deep. The finished wardrobe matches it, drawers and all.

steps.title: Frames in
steps.text: PAX frames built and stood against the wall, drawers fitted inside.

image.alt: White PAX frames with wire drawers, tools on the floor

steps.title: Second side
steps.text: The second run goes in on the other side of the room.

image.alt: PAX frames beside the window on the second side

steps.title: Both sides up
steps.text: Frames in on both sides, with the window between them.

image.alt: PAX frames along both walls with the window in the middle

steps.title: Boxed in and doors on
steps.text: MDF panels close the gaps to the ceiling and walls, then full-height MDF doors go on.

image.alt: Finished MDF wardrobe with three doors and knobs
